title: Line force in an elastic solid: 2D elastodynamic Green's function (analytic)
description:
A cw point force (force_source, 1 MHz, F per m of z, along +x) at the centre of a 45 mm silica-like square (elastic_waves, isotropic: cL 5960, cS 3760 m/s; 40 cells per shear wavelength, 64-cell absorbing layers inside the domain), run for ~40 periods (~3 s).
Analytic (rho dv/dt = div s + F sin(w t) x delta, time convention exp(+j w t), g = -(j/4) H0^(2)(k r) the outgoing solution of (lap + k^2) g = -delta): U_xx = g_S / mu + (1 / (rho w^2)) d^2(g_S - g_P)/dx^2, i.e. with c = X / r, s = Y / r (X along the force): U_xx = -(j/4) [ (s^2 H0(kS r) + (c^2 - s^2) H1(kS r)/(kS r)) / mu + (c^2 H0(kP r) - (c^2 - s^2) H1(kP r)/(kP r)) / M ], mu = rho cS^2, M = rho cL^2; v_x = Im[j w F U_xx e^(j w t)] = (w F / 4) [J sin(w t) - Y cos(w t)] with J, Y the same brackets of J0, J1 (Y0, Y1). Along the force the far field is the P wave (H0(kP r) / M), across it the S wave (H0(kS r) / mu); both lines carry the 1/r^2 near field of the other wave.
Line profile tab (final state, v_x at t_end - dt/2): vx_along_force (y = y_s, P) and vx_across_force (x = x_s, S), from 12 to 160 cells out; v_x sits on the +x cell face, so the curves use X = x + dx/2 - x_s in the general (c, s) formula, which also holds half a cell off the axis. Expected ~1 % of the curve range (grid dispersion ~1e-3 in phase speed over up to 4 shear wavelengths, CPML reflections, the source split over the two x faces of its cell); tolerance 3 % (P) / 4 % (S), to be confirmed by a first run.
Probes tab: probe_P (100.5 cells along +x) and probe_S (100 cells along +y) with the steady state times the source ramp (approximate while the ramp lasts).
Derived values tab: pp_mean_P / pp_mean_S = time mean of 2 v_x^2 over the last 10 periods vs (w F / 4)^2 (J^2 + Y^2) at the v_x node (tolerance 6 %).

parameters.name: f0
parameters.description: source frequency

parameters.name: w_ang
parameters.description: angular frequency in rad/s

parameters.name: rho_s
parameters.description: solid density in kg/m^3

parameters.name: cL_s
parameters.description: longitudinal (P) speed in m/s

parameters.name: cS_s
parameters.description: shear (S) speed in m/s

parameters.name: mu_s
parameters.description: shear modulus mu in Pa (31.1 GPa)

parameters.name: M_s
parameters.description: P-wave modulus lambda + 2 mu in Pa (78.1 GPa)

parameters.name: kP
parameters.description: P wavenumber in 1/m

parameters.name: kS
parameters.description: S wavenumber in 1/m

parameters.name: dx_cell
parameters.description: uniform cell size (40 cells per shear wavelength, 63 per P wavelength; 94 um)

parameters.name: L_box
parameters.description: domain side (480 cells, 45 mm)

parameters.name: n_pml
parameters.description: absorbing layer cells per face (6 mm, one P wavelength)

parameters.name: x_s
parameters.description: source x (cell centre)

parameters.name: y_s
parameters.description: source y (cell centre)

parameters.name: x_v
parameters.description: x_s minus half a cell: X = x - x_v is the offset of the v_x node (+x face) of the cell centred at x

parameters.name: F_line
parameters.description: peak line force per m of z in N/m (along +x)

parameters.name: v_amp
parameters.description: velocity prefactor w F / 4 (times the 1/Pa brackets)

parameters.name: S_courant
parameters.description: courant setting

parameters.name: dt_ac
parameters.description: acoustic step: courant / (cL sqrt(2) / dx) (uniform isotropic solid, no vacuum)

parameters.name: T_run
parameters.description: study duration (an eighth period past whole periods: both brackets show)

parameters.name: t_end
parameters.description: final time: the tick nearest T_run

parameters.name: t_vel
parameters.description: time of the final velocities (half a step before t_end)

parameters.name: t_avg0
parameters.description: start of the 10-period averaging window

parameters.name: tau_ramp
parameters.description: time constant of the cw switch-on ramp 1 - exp(-t / tau)

parameters.name: rP
parameters.description: probe_P v_x node distance along +x (on the force axis)

parameters.name: JP
parameters.description: J bracket at probe_P (c = 1, s = 0) in 1/Pa

parameters.name: YP
parameters.description: Y bracket at probe_P in 1/Pa

parameters.name: rS
parameters.description: probe_S v_x node distance (half a cell along x, 100 cells along +y)

parameters.name: c2S
parameters.description: cos^2 of the probe_S direction to the force

parameters.name: s2S
parameters.description: sin^2 of the probe_S direction to the force

parameters.name: JS
parameters.description: J bracket at probe_S in 1/Pa

parameters.name: YS
parameters.description: Y bracket at probe_S in 1/Pa

analytic_curves.name: vx_along_force
analytic_curves.expression: v_amp*((((y - y_s)**2*j0(kS*hypot(x - x_v, y - y_s)) + ((x - x_v)**2 - (y - y_s)**2)*j1(kS*hypot(x - x_v, y - y_s))/(kS*hypot(x - x_v, y - y_s)))/mu_s + ((x - x_v)**2*j0(kP*hypot(x - x_v, y - y_s)) - ((x - x_v)**2 - (y - y_s)**2)*j1(kP*hypot(x - x_v, y - y_s))/(kP*hypot(x - x_v, y - y_s)))/M_s)*sin(w_ang*t_vel) - (((y - y_s)**2*y0(kS*hypot(x - x_v, y - y_s)) + ((x - x_v)**2 - (y - y_s)**2)*y1(kS*hypot(x - x_v, y - y_s))/(kS*hypot(x - x_v, y - y_s)))/mu_s + ((x - x_v)**2*y0(kP*hypot(x - x_v, y - y_s)) - ((x - x_v)**2 - (y - y_s)**2)*y1(kP*hypot(x - x_v, y - y_s))/(kP*hypot(x - x_v, y - y_s)))/M_s)*cos(w_ang*t_vel))/hypot(x - x_v, y - y_s)**2

analytic_curves.name: vx_across_force
analytic_curves.expression: v_amp*((((y - y_s)**2*j0(kS*hypot(x - x_v, y - y_s)) + ((x - x_v)**2 - (y - y_s)**2)*j1(kS*hypot(x - x_v, y - y_s))/(kS*hypot(x - x_v, y - y_s)))/mu_s + ((x - x_v)**2*j0(kP*hypot(x - x_v, y - y_s)) - ((x - x_v)**2 - (y - y_s)**2)*j1(kP*hypot(x - x_v, y - y_s))/(kP*hypot(x - x_v, y - y_s)))/M_s)*sin(w_ang*t_vel) - (((y - y_s)**2*y0(kS*hypot(x - x_v, y - y_s)) + ((x - x_v)**2 - (y - y_s)**2)*y1(kS*hypot(x - x_v, y - y_s))/(kS*hypot(x - x_v, y - y_s)))/mu_s + ((x - x_v)**2*y0(kP*hypot(x - x_v, y - y_s)) - ((x - x_v)**2 - (y - y_s)**2)*y1(kP*hypot(x - x_v, y - y_s))/(kP*hypot(x - x_v, y - y_s)))/M_s)*cos(w_ang*t_vel))/hypot(x - x_v, y - y_s)**2
